This one works fine too — going into the editor with the pencil, typing "typography" alongside the title and description, and saving pulls it onto the card as a pill just the same. Nothing wrong with it.

Comparing the two, though, I lean toward adding labels right on the card. Slapping a quick label on something is a small, frequent little act for me, and having it right there under the bookmark — without opening the whole editor — fits that. The editor feels better suited to when I'm sitting down to properly rework a bookmark's title and description, and tidying labels at the same time.

So my pick is the direct-on-the-card placement, version A. But honestly I'd like *both* to exist eventually — quick-add on the card for the fast case, and the labels also editable inside the editor when I'm already in there reworking things. As long as I can add and reuse labels, both spots doing it wouldn't bother me. For settling placement: version A is my choice.
